unitree-g1.description: Unitree G1 is currently the world's leading research-grade humanoid robot by shipment volume. With a starting price under 100,000 RMB and excellent motion control, it has become the mainstream choice for universities and research institutions, and supports full-pipeline reinforcement learning development.
highlights: Starting at 99,000 RMB, greatly lowering the barrier to humanoid robots
Powerful joints enable highly dynamic motions such as running, jumping and rolling over
Compact when folded and can be carried by one person
Mature development ecosystem with a large number of research citations

specs.sdk: Open SDK, supports ROS2 / reinforcement learning simulation

unitree-g1.priceNote: Starting price for the base version; the EDU version costs more

unitree-go2.description: Unitree Go2 is the benchmark product among consumer-grade quadruped robots. It offers LiDAR-based autonomous obstacle avoidance and highly dynamic motion at a price of around 10,000 RMB, and is also one of the most widely used quadruped platforms in research.
highlights: Consumer price at around 10,000 RMB, with world-leading shipment volume
Standard 4D LiDAR with strong autonomous obstacle avoidance
Excellent motion performance, supporting moves such as backflips
Comprehensive accessories and development ecosystem

specs.sdk: Open SDK, supports ROS / Python

unitree-go2.priceNote: Starting price for the Air version; Pro/EDU versions cost more

inspire-rh56.description: The Inspire RH56 series is one of the most commercially mature dexterous hands in China. Using a miniature linear servo drive, it balances weight, cost and reliability, and is widely integrated into various humanoid robot bodies.
highlights: A commercial dexterous hand with leading shipment volume in China
Size and weight close to an adult human hand, easy to integrate
6 active DOF covering common grasping tasks
Chosen as the default end effector by multiple humanoid robot makers

specs.speed_note: Single finger flexion in approx. 1 second
specs.sdk: SDK and ROS driver provided

unitree-h1-2.description: Unitree H1-2 is a full-size humanoid robot from Unitree Robotics for research and performance scenarios. Upgraded from the H1, it stands approx. 180 cm tall, has high joint torque and excellent motion performance, and provides open development interfaces. It is commonly used in motion control and reinforcement learning research.
highlights: Full-size 180 cm humanoid with high joint torque, suited to highly dynamic research
Whole-body DOF upgraded over the H1, with more agile legs and arms
Official motion control is open, making it easy to validate reinforcement learning algorithms
Has repeatedly demonstrated highly dynamic performances such as running and dancing

specs.compute_platform: Intel Core i7 + optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin (subject to official configuration)
specs.sdk: Open SDK, supports ROS2 / reinforcement learning

tesla-optimus-gen2.description: Tesla Optimus Gen 2 was unveiled in late 2023. Compared with the first generation, it is approx. 10 kg lighter, walks faster, and its hands have 11 DOF with tactile sensing. It is currently tested mainly inside Tesla factories and is not sold externally; mass-production timing and pricing are subject to official announcements.
highlights: About 10 kg lighter than the previous generation, with faster walking speed
Approx. 28 actuators across the body, 11 DOF per hand
Fingers integrate tactile sensing, enabling fine-grained grasping
Built on Tesla's FSD vision and in-house chip stack

specs.sensors: Primarily vision-based, with tactile sensors in the fingertips
specs.sdk: Not open, internal use only

tesla-optimus-gen2.priceNote: Not disclosed; officially a long-term target price of approx. 20,000-30,000 USD has been mentioned, but no mass-production quote yet

figure-02.description: Figure 02 is the second-generation commercial humanoid robot released by Figure AI in 2024. It stands approx. 170 cm tall, has 16-DOF dexterous hands and 6 cameras, has been piloted in automotive factories, and is paired with the Helix model for language-driven manipulation tasks.
highlights: Pilot deployment at a BMW factory
16 DOF per hand with strong fingertip load capacity
Built-in 2.25 kWh battery, approx. 5 hours of runtime
Paired with the Helix VLA model, supporting natural language interaction

specs.compute_platform: Onboard GPU inference, with approx. 3x the compute of the previous generation
specs.sensors: 6 RGB cameras + onboard microphones and speakers
specs.sdk: Not open, targeted commercial partnerships

figure-03.description: Figure 03 was released in October 2025 as the third-generation humanoid robot from Figure AI, designed for home and commercial scenarios. It is lighter with a softer exterior, has cameras in the palms and tactile sensing in the fingertips, and is planned for large-scale mass production through its own factory.
highlights: Designed for both home and commercial use, with a soft fabric-covered exterior
Cameras built into the palms and tactile sensing in the fingertips
Supports wireless charging, improving continuous operation efficiency
Redesigned specifically for Helix and large-scale mass production

specs.compute_platform: Onboard GPU for Helix model inference
specs.sensors: Head and palm cameras + fingertip tactile sensors
specs.sdk: Not open, targeted commercial partnerships

boston-dynamics-atlas.description: In April 2024, Boston Dynamics released the new all-electric Atlas, replacing the hydraulic version. Its joints can rotate through a wide range, it stands approx. 150 cm tall, and it is mainly being developed with Hyundai for factory applications, alongside research on whole-body manipulation based on large models.
highlights: All-electric version released in 2024, replacing the hydraulic Atlas
Wide joint rotation range enables superhuman twisting motions
Developed with Hyundai for factory scenarios
Collaborating with Toyota Research Institute on large behavior model research

specs.sensors: Multiple head cameras and depth sensing
specs.sdk: Not open

agility-digit.description: Digit is a bipedal humanoid robot from Agility Robotics with a bird-like leg structure. It stands approx. 175 cm tall and can carry totes weighing approx. 16 kg. It is one of the earliest commercial humanoid robots to enter real warehouse settings and is offered as Robots-as-a-Service.
highlights: One of the first bipedal humanoid robots in the world to be commercially deployed
Performs real work in logistics warehouses such as GXO
Bipedal with bird-like legs, suited to carrying totes
Paired with the Arc cloud platform, which integrates with warehouse management systems

specs.swappable_battery: Supports autonomous battery swapping and charging
specs.sdk: Integrated via the Agility Arc cloud platform

agility-digit.priceNote: Offered as Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS); quote on request

fourier-gr2.description: Fourier GR-2 is the second-generation general-purpose humanoid robot released by Fourier Intelligence in 2024. It has 53 DOF across the body and 12 DOF per hand, high joint torque, and open development interfaces, and targets embodied AI research and service scenarios such as rehabilitation and care.
highlights: Up to 53 DOF across the body, with 12 DOF per hand
High joint peak torque and ample lower-limb power
Open interfaces for embodied AI development
Fourier has deep actuator expertise in rehabilitation robotics

specs.sensors: Depth camera + tactile sensing (subject to official configuration)
specs.sdk: Open SDK, aimed at embodied AI development

ubtech-walker-s1.description: UBTECH Walker S1 is a humanoid robot for industrial scenarios with approx. 41 DOF across the body. It has entered training programs in several automaker factories, exploring parts handling, quality inspection and multi-robot collaboration, and is one of the earliest humanoid products in China to advance factory training.
highlights: Has entered factories of automakers such as NIO and BYD for training
41 DOF across the body, designed for industrial scenarios
Supports multi-robot collaborative operation
UBTECH has many years of experience in service robotics

specs.sensors: Stereo vision + force sensing (subject to official configuration)
specs.sdk: Targeted cooperation with industrial customers

agibot-a2.description: AgiBot Expedition A2 is a commercial humanoid robot from AgiBot, positioned for guided tours, reception and industrial assistance. Backed by AgiBot's data collection platform and the GO-1 embodied foundation model, it is already being delivered to and explored by multiple customers in China.
highlights: A general-purpose commercial humanoid in AgiBot's Expedition series
Paired with the AgiBot World dataset and the GO-1 model
Targets deployment in guided tours, explanations and industrial scenarios
Backed by AgiBot's mass production and data collection systems

specs.sensors: Multi-camera vision + LiDAR (subject to official configuration)
specs.sdk: Development platform and GO-1 embodied model support provided

engineai-pm01.description: EngineAI PM01 is a small, highly dynamic humanoid robot released by EngineAI in late 2024. It is 138 cm tall, weighs approx. 40 kg, has 24 DOF and high joint torque, is priced at approx. 88,000 RMB, and targets university research and the developer ecosystem.
highlights: A research-grade humanoid starting at approx. 88,000 RMB, with an affordable price
138 cm tall and 40 kg, portable and easy to deploy
Joint peak torque of approx. 164 N·m with good dynamic performance
Open for custom development by universities and developers

specs.compute_platform: Intel N97, optional NVIDIA Jetson Orin (subject to official information)
specs.sdk: Open SDK, for research and developers

engineai-pm01.priceNote: Official reference price of approx. 88,000 RMB; specific versions subject to official information

1x-neo.description: 1X NEO is a home humanoid robot from 1X Technologies that opened pre-orders in October 2025. It weighs approx. 30 kg, uses a soft exterior and tendon-driven actuation, is low-noise, has a pre-order price of approx. 20,000 USD, and is planned for delivery to US households in 2026.
highlights: A consumer humanoid designed for the home, with a pre-order price of 20,000 USD
Approx. 30 kg with a soft fabric exterior and tendon drive, running quietly
Can carry objects weighing approx. 25 kg
Paired with the 1X world model, supporting household task learning and remote assistance

specs.sdk: Not open, a home product

1x-neo.priceNote: Pre-order price 20,000 USD, or subscription at approx. 499 USD/month; delivery planned for 2026

galbot-g1.description: Galbot G1 from Galbot is a wheeled dual-arm general-purpose robot with a mobile base, lifting column and dual arms. Backed by an embodied foundation model trained on large-scale synthetic data, it is being piloted in scenarios such as retail and pharmacies.
highlights: Wheeled base + dual arms + lifting structure, suited to shelf work
Embodied foundation model trained on large-scale synthetic data
Already deployed in scenarios such as retail pharmacies
Secured multiple large funding rounds, with fast commercialization

specs.sensors: Head and wrist cameras + LiDAR (subject to official information)
specs.sdk: Development interfaces provided, supporting integration of embodied foundation models

astribot-s1.description: Astribot S1 from Astribot is a wheeled dual-arm AI assistant robot. It uses a rope-driven structure for fast, flexible dual-arm manipulation, has been demonstrated folding clothes and tidying items, targets home service and general assistant scenarios, and is currently available mainly through targeted partnerships.
highlights: Fast and highly dexterous dual arms, demonstrated folding clothes, pouring tea and more
Rope-driven structure gives human-like manipulation with quick response
Positioned for home service and general assistant use
Data collection combines teleoperation and imitation learning

specs.sdk: Targeted cooperation, supports imitation learning

agibot-genie-g1.description: AgiBot Genie G1 is a wheeled dual-arm manipulation robot from AgiBot with a mobile base and dual-arm configuration. It is mainly used for embodied data collection and industrial logistics operations, and comes with the open-source AgiBot World dataset and the GO-1 embodied foundation model.
highlights: Wheeled dual-arm configuration combining mobility and bimanual manipulation
Designed for data collection and embodied model training
Paired with the open-source AgiBot World dataset
Supports the GO-1 embodied foundation model

specs.sensors: Head and wrist cameras, multimodal perception
specs.sdk: Paired with AgiBot World data collection and the GO-1 model

mobile-aloha.description: Mobile ALOHA is a low-cost open-source mobile bimanual manipulation system proposed by Stanford University in early 2024. Adding a mobile base to the ALOHA bimanual teleoperation setup, it can complete complex household tasks such as cooking and opening cabinet doors with only a small amount of demonstration data, and has become a popular academic platform.
highlights: A low-cost, open-source mobile bimanual manipulation platform
Whole-body teleoperation for data collection, combined with ACT for imitation learning
Learns tasks such as cooking shrimp and opening cabinets from only a few dozen demonstrations
Advanced the open-source embodied data collection ecosystem

specs.sdk: Hardware and code are open source, paired with ACT imitation learning

mobile-aloha.priceNote: The paper reports a total hardware cost of approx. 32,000 USD (including onboard power and compute)

unitree-b2.description: Unitree B2 is a large quadruped robot from Unitree Robotics for industrial scenarios. It has a top speed of approx. 6 m/s, a sustained payload of approx. 40 kg, and IP67 protection for the whole unit, making it suitable for industrial tasks such as power inspection, emergency rescue and outdoor payload transport.
highlights: Industrial-grade quadruped with a top speed of up to 6 m/s
Sustained walking payload of approx. 40 kg, with higher static load capacity
IP67 protection for the whole unit, suited to harsh outdoor environments
Unitree's mature motion control and development ecosystem

specs.sdk: Open SDK, supports ROS / Python

boston-dynamics-spot.description: Spot is Boston Dynamics' commercial quadruped robot. It weighs approx. 32.5 kg, has a sustained payload of approx. 14 kg, can carry sensors through its payload ports for autonomous inspection, and comes with a mature SDK and mission orchestration software. It is widely used in the energy, construction and security industries.
highlights: One of the longest-commercialized and most widely deployed commercial quadruped robots
Expandable payload ports support thermal imaging, gas detection and more
Mature autonomous navigation and mission orchestration software, Autowalk
Well-documented Spot SDK and a rich ecosystem

specs.sensors: 5 stereo camera pairs + optional pan-tilt camera and LiDAR payloads
specs.sdk: Spot SDK provided, supports Python / ROS

boston-dynamics-spot.priceNote: Base version starts at approx. 74,500 USD; accessories are extra

anybotics-anymal-d.description: ANYmal D is an industrial inspection quadruped robot from ANYbotics of Switzerland. It weighs approx. 50 kg, has IP67 protection and autonomous charging, and its X version is explosion-proof certified, making it suitable for autonomous inspection in hazardous environments such as oil and gas, chemical plants and substations.
highlights: For industrial inspection in oil and gas, chemicals and more, with IP67 protection
The ANYmal X version holds explosion-proof (ATEX) certification
Autonomous charging and long-term autonomous inspection
Originated from ETH Zurich robotics research, with deep academic expertise
applications: Oil, gas and chemical facility inspection

specs.sensors: LiDAR + depth camera + thermal imaging and acoustic inspection
specs.sdk: ANYmal software and research interfaces provided

deeprobotics-x30.description: Jueying X30 is an industrial-grade quadruped robot from DEEP Robotics. It weighs approx. 56 kg, has IP67 protection and strong rough-terrain capability, and has been deployed in scenarios such as power inspection, emergency rescue and security patrol, making it a representative Chinese industrial quadruped.
highlights: A Chinese industrial-grade quadruped for power and emergency scenarios
IP67 protection, adapted to complex outdoor environments
Can climb stairs and steep slopes
DEEP Robotics has many deployments in power inspection and other fields in China

specs.sensors: LiDAR + depth camera (subject to official configuration)
specs.sdk: Custom development interfaces provided

ghost-vision-60.description: Vision 60 is an all-terrain quadruped robot from Ghost Robotics. It weighs approx. 51 kg, uses a direct-drive leg structure and a highly protected design, has many applications in US military, police and security, and can carry various sensor payloads for patrol and reconnaissance missions.
highlights: Designed for demanding environments such as military, police and security
Direct-drive legs, mechanically simple and durable
High ingress protection, suited to deserts, snow and other environments
A variety of optional payload expansions

specs.sdk: Payload interfaces and development support provided

shadow-dexterous-hand.description: The Shadow Dexterous Hand from Shadow Robot of the UK is an anthropomorphic dexterous hand with 24 DOF, 20 of them actuated. It has long been the benchmark platform for robotic dexterous manipulation research, was used in OpenAI's Rubik's Cube experiment, and is expensive, with pricing on request.
highlights: Anthropomorphic structure with 24 DOF, 20 of them actuated
A benchmark dexterous hand long used in research
Used in classic work such as OpenAI's Rubik's Cube experiment
ROS drivers and simulation models provided

specs.tactile: Optional fingertip tactile sensors such as BioTac
specs.sdk: ROS drivers and simulation models provided

unitree-dex3-1.description: Unitree Dex3-1 is a three-fingered dexterous hand developed by Unitree Robotics for the G1 humanoid robot. It has 7 DOF in total and an integrated tactile sensor array, and is mainly used for dexterous manipulation research and teleoperation data collection on the G1 EDU. It is the force-sensing dexterous hand of the Unitree ecosystem.
highlights: Three fingers with 7 DOF, designed for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot
Integrated tactile sensor array, supporting force feedback
Can be used for teleoperation data collection
The companion dexterous hand for the Unitree G1 EDU

specs.tactile: Tactile sensor arrays on fingertips and finger segments
specs.sdk: Companion to the G1 EDU, SDK provided

wonik-allegro-hand.description: The Allegro Hand from Wonik Robotics of South Korea is a four-fingered, 16-DOF, fully actuated dexterous hand. It has a compact structure and comprehensive simulation model and ROS support, and is one of the most widely used research dexterous hands in reinforcement learning, grasping and dexterous manipulation research.
highlights: Four fingers, 16 DOF, fully actuated structure
A classic dexterous hand widely used in the research community
Comprehensive open-source simulation models, convenient for reinforcement learning
Priced lower than comparable anthropomorphic dexterous hands

specs.sdk: ROS and simulation support provided

leap-hand.description: LEAP Hand is a low-cost dexterous hand open-sourced by Carnegie Mellon University in 2023. It uses Dynamixel servos to drive four fingers with 16 DOF, costs approx. 2,000 USD for the whole hand, has fully open-source hardware and code, and has become an entry-level platform for dexterous manipulation research.
highlights: Open-source low-cost dexterous hand, approx. 2,000 USD for the whole hand
Four fingers with 16 DOF, open-source structure that is easy to reproduce
Supports sim-to-real dexterous manipulation research
Widely reproduced by the community, convenient for getting started in research

specs.sdk: Open-source hardware and Python / ROS code

leap-hand.priceNote: The paper reports a whole-hand cost of approx. 2,000 USD (open-source, self-built)

leaderdrive-harmonic-reducer.description: Leaderdrive is a leading Chinese harmonic gear (strain wave gear) manufacturer. Its products cover multiple series and reduction ratios and are widely used in industrial robots, collaborative robots and humanoid robot joints. It is a representative company in the domestic substitution of core robot transmission components.
highlights: A leading Chinese harmonic gear maker, supplying core components for robot joints
Products cover multiple series and reduction ratios
Widely adopted in humanoid robot joints and collaborative robots
A representative company in the domestic substitution drive

specs.model_series: LCS / LHS and other series (specific models per the official manual)
specs.key_params: Parameters vary widely between models; please refer to the official selection manual

livox-mid-360.description: Livox Mid-360 is a compact 3D LiDAR from Livox Technology, a DJI-affiliated company. It has a 360° horizontal field of view, weighs approx. 265 g, delivers approx. 200,000 points per second and has a built-in IMU. It is commonly used for SLAM mapping and obstacle avoidance navigation on quadruped, humanoid and mobile robots.
highlights: 360° horizontal field of view, suited to mobile robot mapping and obstacle avoidance
Small size and approx. 265 g weight, easy to integrate
Built-in IMU, supports SLAM algorithms
Adopted by multiple robot makers including Unitree

specs.range_note: Detection range approx. 40 m (10% reflectivity), field of view 360° × 59°
specs.key_params: Point rate 200,000 points/s, built-in IMU, IP67 ingress protection

livox-mid-360.priceNote: Overseas official reference price approx. 749 USD; subject to the channel

intel-realsense-d435i.description: The Intel RealSense D435i is a widely used stereo depth camera with a global shutter depth sensor and built-in IMU, and comprehensive SDK and ROS support. It is commonly used for robot obstacle avoidance, visual SLAM and grasp perception, and is a classic choice for research and development.
highlights: Global shutter depth sensing, suited to robots in motion
Built-in IMU, supports visual-inertial SLAM
Mature ecosystem with comprehensive SDK and ROS support
Adopted by a large number of research and development projects

specs.component_type: Active infrared stereo depth camera (with IMU)
specs.range_note: Depth resolution up to 1280×720, field of view approx. 87° × 58°
specs.key_params: Global shutter depth sensor, built-in IMU, up to 90 fps

intel-realsense-d435i.priceNote: Price fluctuates by channel, approx. a few hundred USD; please refer to channel quotes

ati-mini45.description: The ATI Mini45 is a compact 6-axis force/torque sensor from ATI of the US. With a diameter of approx. 45 mm and a weight of approx. 92 g, it is widely used for robot wrist force control, precision assembly and research testing, and is one of the industry benchmarks in 6-axis force sensing. Pricing on request.
highlights: An industry-benchmark brand in 6-axis force sensing
Small, weighing approx. 92 g, easy to integrate on the wrist
Multiple measurement ranges available, from precision assembly to heavy loads
Widely used in force control research and industrial applications

specs.model_series: Mini45 (including range specifications such as SI-145-5)
specs.range_note: SI-145-5 specification: Fx/Fy 145 N, Fz 290 N, torque approx. 5 N·m
specs.interface: Net F/T / DAQ, etc. (depending on options)
specs.key_params: Outer diameter approx. 45 mm, strain-gauge-based 6-axis measurement, multiple ranges also available

nvidia-jetson-agx-orin.description: Jetson AGX Orin is NVIDIA's edge AI computing platform for robotics. The 64GB version delivers up to approx. 275 TOPS, power is adjustable between 15 and 60 W, and it comes with the JetPack and Isaac ecosystem. It is a commonly used main controller for humanoid and quadruped robots.
highlights: The 64GB version offers up to approx. 275 TOPS of edge AI compute
Full ecosystem support for JetPack, Isaac and ROS
A widely adopted main controller platform for humanoid and quadruped robots
Adjustable power, balancing performance and efficiency
applications: Humanoid and quadruped robot main controller

specs.key_params: Up to approx. 275 TOPS (64GB version), 12-core Arm CPU, Ampere GPU, power approx. 15-60 W

nvidia-jetson-agx-orin.priceNote: Developer kit reference price approx. 1,999 USD; module pricing is separate

unitree-r1.description: Unitree R1 is an entry-level lightweight humanoid robot from Unitree Robotics. Standing approx. 123 cm tall and weighing approx. 29 kg with 26 DOF and dynamic motion capability, the R1 AIR starts at 4,900 USD while the EDU edition offers open development interfaces.
highlights: R1 AIR starts at 4,900 USD, sharply lowering the entry barrier to bipedal humanoids
Approx. 123 cm tall and 29 kg with battery, compact and portable
26 DOF high-dynamic joints capable of running, cartwheels and handstands
R1 EDU edition supports research and secondary development

specs.compute_platform: Built-in multimodal LLM for voice and vision interaction
specs.sensors: Stereo vision + microphone array + dual 6-axis IMUs
specs.sdk: R1 EDU supports secondary development with open joint and sensor interfaces

unitree-r1.priceNote: R1 AIR starts at 4,900 USD, standard at 5,900 USD (approx. 39,999 RMB in China), EDU at approx. 10,500 USD

unitree-h2.description: Unitree H2 is Unitree Robotics' next-generation 182 cm full-size humanoid robot. Weighing approx. 70 kg with 31 DOF, up to 360 N·m knee torque, and 7 kg rated arm payload, higher-end configurations support NVIDIA Jetson Thor and optional 5-finger tactile dexterous hands.
highlights: 182 cm full-size humanoid with a bionic face for improved HRI
31 DOF across the body with up to 360 N·m peak knee torque
H2 EDU / H2 Plus supports optional NVIDIA Jetson Thor (2,070 TOPS)
972 Wh battery providing up to approx. 3 hours of runtime

specs.compute_platform: Intel Core i5 / i7 + optional NVIDIA Jetson Thor (2,070 TOPS)
specs.sdk: H2 EDU offers an open SDK with secondary development and optional dexterous hands

unitree-h2.priceNote: Official reference from 29,900 USD (commercial/EDU channels higher); H2 Plus with Jetson Thor approx. 100,000 USD

unitree-a2.description: Unitree A2 is Unitree Robotics' next-generation quadruped robot for industrial inspection and heavy payloads. Weighing approx. 37 kg with batteries, it reaches 5 m/s top speed, carries a 25 kg continuous payload with approx. 20 km range, and offers wheeled A2-W and Pro variants.
highlights: Next-gen industrial quadruped with a top speed of 5 m/s
Approx. 25 kg continuous walking payload and up to 100 kg standing load
Hot-swappable dual batteries with approx. 20 km total range
Available in wheel-legged A2-W and Pro variants for diverse inspection needs

specs.sensors: LiDAR + depth camera (expandable on A2 Pro / A2-W)
specs.sdk: Open SDK supporting ROS and industrial custom development

unitree-a2.priceNote: Overseas reference: A2 approx. 31,800 USD, A2 Pro approx. 40,800 USD, wheel-legged A2-W from approx. 36,800 USD

booster-k1.description: Booster K1 is a compact humanoid robot for education, competitions and embodied AI entry. Standing approx. 95 cm tall and weighing 19.5 kg with 22 DOF, it offers three onboard compute tiers up to 200 TOPS and a complete simulation toolchain.
highlights: 95 cm tall and 19.5 kg, portable enough to carry with one hand
22 DOF built for education, RoboCup competitions and RL onboarding
Three onboard AI compute options up to 200 TOPS
Paired with Booster GYM 2.0 and open SDK

specs.compute_platform: Three onboard AI compute tiers: 48 / 117 / 200 TOPS
specs.sdk: Open API and Booster GYM 2.0, supporting ROS2 and simulation

booster-k1.priceNote: Geek edition approx. 7,500 USD, EDU approx. 9,999 USD, Professional approx. 11,998-12,500 USD

booster-t2.description: Booster T2 is a flagship embodied development humanoid released in 2026. Standing 140 cm tall and weighing 42 kg with 31 DOF and full torque-controlled joints, the Pro edition features NVIDIA Jetson Thor (2,070 TOPS) for mobile manipulation and real-world VLA validation.
highlights: 140 cm tall with 31 DOF (7-DOF dual arms + 3-DOF waist)
Full torque-controlled joints, 3 m/s walking speed and 10 kg dual-arm payload
Pro edition powered by NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000 (2,070 TOPS)
Supports grippers and multiple tactile dexterous hand options
applications: Mobile manipulation and embodied AI research
Dexterous hand and VLA real-robot validation

specs.compute_platform: Edu: ARM (375 TOPS) / Pro: NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000 (2,070 TOPS)
specs.sdk: Full joint torque control and low-level open SDK; supports grippers and dexterous hands

booster-t2.priceNote: Edu from approx. 32,999-38,850 USD; Pro (with Jetson Thor) from approx. 37,999-48,999 USD

agibot-x2.description: AgiBot X2 is a compact, highly interactive humanoid robot from AgiBot. Standing approx. 131 cm tall and weighing approx. 35 kg (25 DOF standard, 30 DOF on Ultra), it focuses on expressive interaction and agile motion for exhibitions, research and education.
highlights: Approx. 131 cm tall and 35 kg, balancing dynamic motion and expressive interaction
25 DOF on base model, expandable to 30 DOF on X2 Ultra
Approx. 2 hours runtime for reception, research and commercial interaction
Available in Neo / EDU / Ultra configurations

specs.sdk: Developer documentation provided for interaction and motion control

agibot-x2.priceNote: X2 Neo official store reference approx. 25,600 USD (some channels from 27,999 USD); EDU and Ultra also available

tesla-optimus-gen3.description: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 advanced toward initial Fremont pilot production lines in 2026, upgrading to 22-DOF hands and Tesla's AI5 compute architecture. Full specifications and mass-production pricing remain undisclosed, with testing still focused on internal Tesla factories.
highlights: Hands upgraded to 22 DOF for significantly finer manipulation
Initial production lines installed at Fremont factory in July 2026
Powered by Tesla's next-generation AI5 compute platform
Target 20 kg payload for factory lines and future home service

specs.sensors: Vision-based perception + new 22-DOF hand tactile sensing
specs.sdk: Not open, internal production line deployment

tesla-optimus-gen3.priceNote: Not disclosed; initial Fremont lines installed July 2026, long-term target 20,000-30,000 USD

noetix-n2.description: Noetix N2 is a high-burst bipedal humanoid platform for developers from Noetix Robotics. Standing 120 cm tall and weighing 30 kg with 18 DOF, it reaches 3.2 m/s running speed and performs consecutive backflips, starting around 39,900 RMB.
highlights: High-burst bipedal platform starting around 39,900 RMB
120 cm tall and 30 kg using 18 high-performance joints for agile motion
First bipedal humanoid to demonstrate consecutive multi-scene backflips, running up to 3.2 m/s
Supports LLM voice interaction and rapid custom development

specs.sensors: Vision obstacle avoidance + voice interaction module
specs.sdk: Multiple control interfaces included for research and rapid development

noetix-n2.priceNote: Official launch starting price approx. 39,900 RMB; subject to configuration

noetix-bumi.description: Noetix Bumi (Xiao Bu Mi) launched in October 2025 at 9,998 RMB as the world's first high-performance consumer humanoid under 10,000 RMB. Standing approx. 94 cm tall and weighing approx. 12 kg with 21+ DOF, it targets home companionship and STEM education.
highlights: Priced at 9,998 RMB, bringing high-performance humanoids under 10,000 RMB
Approx. 94 cm tall and 12 kg, lightweight and safe for home settings
21+ DOF supporting running, dancing and dynamic motions
Designed for home companionship and youth coding education

specs.sdk: Geared toward consumer companionship and lightweight educational programming

magiclab-magicbot.description: MagicLab MagicBot is a general-purpose full-size humanoid robot with 42 DOF across the body, up to 20 kg bimanual carrying payload, 40 kg total payload, and up to 5 hours of continuous mixed locomotion and manipulation runtime.
highlights: 42 DOF across the body; up to 20 kg bimanual payload and 40 kg total payload
Up to 5 hours of combined walking and manipulation runtime
In-house torque-motor joints, drivers, controllers and dexterous hands
Deployed in pilot industrial production lines and commercial service scenarios
